questions.q: Which formula correctly states the Sine Rule in any triangle ABC with sides a, b, c opposite to angles A, B, C?
a: a / sin(A) = b / sin(B) = c / sin(C)
sin(A) / a = sin(B) / b = sin(C) / c

When you know a side and its opposite angle
